details.question: I am using persistent messages, but I never got the messages. How can I determine what happen to the messages?
details.answer:
To determine what happened to the persistent messages, you should check the SystemOut.log for each messaging server in the "ISIM Messaging" cluster. Look for specific entries that indicate the status of the messaging engine. A working node will have an entry indicating it has acquired an exclusive lock on the data store, while non-working nodes will show messages indicating a failure to gain an initial lock or no response from the messaging engine [swg21591133#4]. 

Additionally, you could enable the 'DEBUG' log level of the 'Integration' root logger to see what key MIF is looking at and the value being retrieved. If the key value is not provided in the import data file, you may see relevant log messages indicating this issue [swg22013228#3].
